text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: go mod download
    - name: Run linter
      run: golangci-lint run --fix

  build-and-test:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: go mod download
    - name: Format code
      run: go fmt ./...
    - name: Build project
      run: go build ./...
    - name: Run tests
      run: go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out
    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        file: coverage.out
        flags: unittests
        name: codecov-go
        fail_ci_if_error: true
```
